tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally filtered by status, priority, project, or top3 flag.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task with optional project, priority, due date, and recurrence.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an existing task. Only provided fields are changed.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Toggle a task between completed and pending. Cascades to subtasks and handles recurrence.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.description: Soft-delete a task (can be restored later).

tools.name: list_habits
tools.description: List active habits with the value logged and done status for a date, plus current streaks. Streaks count from yesterday while today is still open; times_per_week habits have weekly streaks (streak_unit=weeks).

tools.name: create_habit
tools.description: Create a new habit. Tracking types: check (daily toggle), count (hit a number), duration (minutes), times_per_week (weekly frequency).

tools.name: update_habit
tools.description: Update an existing habit. Only provided fields are changed.

tools.name: log_habit
tools.description: Log a habit entry for a date. Sets the value for a day (0 clears it). Without a value the day is marked fully done.

tools.name: list_goals
tools.description: List goals with progress, type, and status. Supports filtering by status or category.

tools.name: create_goal
tools.description: Create a new goal. Types: milestone (checklist), numeric (value tracking), habit, vision.

tools.name: update_goal
tools.description: Update a goal: change status, progress, toggle milestones, or add a progress note.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects with task counts, tier, status, and linked goal.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project with tier (A/B/C), optional goal link, and target date.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update a project: change name, tier, status, goal link, or target date.

tools.name: get_daily_entry
tools.description: Get the daily journal entry for a date: mood, energy, focus, morning/evening notes.

tools.name: update_daily_entry
tools.description: Update the daily journal: set mood (1-5), energy (1-5), focus text, morning/evening notes.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes, optionally filtered by search query or tag. Returns title, tags, and truncated body.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new note with title, body text, and optional tags.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Soft-delete a note.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: List books with optional status filter. Returns title, author, status, progress, and rating.

tools.name: create_book
tools.description: Add a book to your library. Set status to "reading", "wishlist", "to_check", etc.

tools.name: update_book
tools.description: Update a book: change status, rating, notes, or update reading progress (current page).

tools.name: delete_book
tools.description: Delete a book from the library.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List saved quotes, optionally filtered by book or favorites only.

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: Save a quote with author and optional book link.

tools.name: add_bookmark
tools.description: Save a bookmark URL with optional title, description, category, and tags.

tools.name: delete_bookmark
tools.description: Delete a bookmark permanently.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List financial accounts with balances and types.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List transaction categories with type (income/expense) and monthly budget.

tools.name: add_transaction
tools.description: Add a financial transaction (income or expense) to an account with optional category.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List active subscriptions with amounts, frequency, and next billing date.

tools.name: create_subscription
tools.description: Add a recurring subscription (monthly, yearly, or weekly).

tools.name: list_holdings
tools.description: List portfolio holdings with market value, P/L, and allocation. Totals are in the user's currency; holdings without a live price are valued at cost and have null P/L.

tools.name: add_trade
tools.description: Record a buy or sell trade for a portfolio holding. Updates shares and average cost.

tools.name: log_focus_session
tools.description: Log a completed focus/pomodoro session with duration, project, and task link.

tools.name: get_focus_summary
tools.description: Get focus time summary: total minutes, sessions, and breakdown by project for a date range.

tools.name: log_workout
tools.description: Log a workout session with type, duration, calories, and heart rate.

tools.name: log_workout_sets
tools.description: Add exercises and sets to a workout. Accepts gym shorthand ("lateral raise 5kg 4x12", "2min rowing machine") and creates the workout for that date if none exists.

tools.name: log_body_measurement
tools.description: Log body measurements: weight, body fat %, waist, chest, etc.

tools.name: log_nutrition
tools.description: Log a day of nutrition — day totals plus optional food-by-food line items. Re-sending the same date replaces that day.

tools.name: list_exercises
tools.description: The movement catalog: canonical names, muscle groups and the aliases that resolve to them. Check here before logging sets — using the catalog name keeps one lift on one row instead of splitting its history across near-duplicates.

tools.name: get_fitness_summary
tools.description: Current fitness state: weight trend vs target rate, waist thresholds, nutrition averages vs macro targets, training frequency and volume, plus which days are missing data.

tools.name: delete_workout
tools.description: Delete a whole training session and every set in it. To remove only part of a session use delete_workout_sets.

tools.name: delete_workout_sets
tools.description: Remove sets from a session without touching the session itself. Use duplicates_only to undo a log that was sent twice, or exercise to drop one movement that was entered by mistake.

tools.name: delete_body_measurement
tools.description: Delete a body measurement that was logged by mistake. Two entries on one date drag the weight trend and the waist rule, so a bad one is worth removing rather than logging over.

tools.name: list_wishlist
tools.description: List wishlist items with price, priority, and purchase status.

tools.name: add_wishlist_item
tools.description: Add an item to the wishlist with price range, priority, and optional URL.

tools.name: update_wishlist_item
tools.description: Update a wishlist item — mark it purchased or cancelled, change priority, price or notes. Purchased and cancelled items drop out of the active list.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts. Filter by relationship type or get contacts needing reach-out.
